about_the_game:
Open packs. Complete card sets. Customize your booth. 

Corner Cards is a relaxing corner-window idle card-collecting game where you set up your booth at a local card convention. 

  • Open Booster Packs - Tear open packs filled with cards of varying rarities, from commons to legendaries and even special cards. 

  • Complete Your Collection - Open your binder to see what cards you're missing and hunt the missing pieces of each set. Chase the thrill of rare pulls!

  • Upgrade Your Booth - Earn money from customers that visit your booth, then reinvest into upgrades to earn more money and unlock new perks. 

  • Relax in the Corner - Designed as an always-on, low-pressure experience, Corner Cards sits neatly in your desktop corner, perfect for playing alongside other tasks. 

With it's cozy pacing, fast pack opening, and quirky customizations, Corner Cards blends the joy of collecting with the calm of an idle game. Whether you're chasing legendary cards or simply letting customers and fans drop by your booth, the corner is always open.

  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD 4000 or better)
